thread:
Rae (People Ops): Heads-up: updating the travel reimbursements cheat-sheet. Need final rules for per-diem, receipts, booking, and receipts-retention. Short and sharable.
Ibrahim (Sales): Can we standardize hotel approvals for client-facing roles? Hotels under $300 ok?
Raj (Finance): For client-facing roles we allow up to $300/night in most metros. Anything above requires manager pre-approval and a line in the expense note. No retroactive approvals.
Tess (Eng): Meals: do we require receipts for every meal when using per-diem?
Raj (Finance): You pick one. Either submit meal receipts OR elect per-diem for the day. If you pick per-diem, don't submit meal receipts for that same day.
Ibrahim (Sales): Small items like taxis/coffee under $20 1--- receipts needed?
Raj (Finance): Receipts required for any single transaction >= $25. Under $25, log item in the expense form as "misc" with brief note; no receipt needed unless merchant insists.
Rae (People Ops): Booking rules to confirm: use TravelPerk when available, corporate card preferred for flights/hotels, personal bookings ok with manager pre-approval. Correct?
Raj (Finance): Yep. Book via TravelPerk or corporate card where possible. If booking personal and seeking reimbursement, attach manager approval (email/Slack) in the expense.
Tess (Eng): Lost receipts? I had a taxi vanish.
Raj (Finance): Missing receipt workflow: if <= $50, include a written explanation. If > $50, upload a Missing Receipt Affidavit and get manager sign-off. Finance may ping for extra verification.
TravelBot: Reminder set: submit expenses within 60 days of trip end. Late claims may be denied. Link: https://redwood.example/internal/travel
Rae (People Ops): Draft checklist I'll publish: 1) TravelPerk/corp-card preferred; 2) Hotel cap $300 client-facing/$250 general; 3) Receipts for >=$25; 4) Per-diem option (meals only) or receipts, not both; 5) Submit within 60 days; 6) Missing receipts: affidavit >$50. Any edits?
Ibrahim (Sales): Add: conference registration requires receipt and business purpose.
Tess (Eng): Add: if trip <12 hours and no overnight, no per-diem.
Raj (Finance): Adding that and country-specific per-diem appendix for internationals. Finance will post sample upload JSON for power users.
Rae (People Ops): Great 1 I'll post the one-pager and ping everyone when live. :rocket:
